title: Truck Titans
description:
Set in the high-octane world of extreme motorsports, TRUCK TITANS is a turbo-charged, adrenaline-fueled racing game where players take on the ultimate challenge: become the undisputed champion of the monster truck circuit.

With corporate sponsors watching, crowds roaring, and millions at stake, every race is a battle. From city arenas to desert speedways and neon-lit night tracks, you’ll tear through more than 9 intense levels of racing, stunts, and explosive Score Attack challenges.

Choose from a lineup of fully customizable monster trucks—each with unique stats, handling, and raw power. Design your driver, pick your sponsors, and modify your rig with upgraded engines, wild paint jobs and more.

Every second counts. Nail jumps, crush obstacles, and chain together combos to rack up high scores and unlock elite tournaments. Compete in local showdowns or global circuits as you rise through the ranks to become a legend in the MTX league.

Crush. Drift. Dominate. Are you monster enough?
description_short: TRUCK TITANS is a high-octane monster truck racing game with 9+ levels of intense action. Customize your truck, pick sponsors, and compete in score attacks and races across city arenas, deserts, and night tracks. Nail stunts, crush obstacles, and become a monster truck legend.
